core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khalood is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Immortality, eternity”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khalood corresponds to the Arabic form خلود (Arabic root خ ل د (kh-l-d); خُلُود (Khulūd)). Its core sense is immortality, eternity. Khalood is Arabic خُلُود (Khulūd) 'immortality, eternity', from the root خ ل د (kh-l-d). The source gloss 'Immortal, Everlasting' is broadly consistent. Same name as kholud, khulood, khuloud and khulud.
